title: An idea becomes a connected system

scenes.title: Idea handed to a shared system
scenes.purpose: Stick Figure Explainer characteristic action: one figure poses to claim an idea, the hand follows the idea to a shared board, a second figure makes contact and the connected system is held.
visuals: Two navy stick figures with dot joints standing on a floor line, an easel board between them
Blue-outlined lightbulb prop with soft pale-blue glow
Network of one filled core node and three ring nodes on the board

beats.development: Choice: the bulb pops in with the 'idea' label; the left figure raises its arm along an arc and its hand settles under the bulb, holding the choice pose from 0.6 s.
captions: An idea becomes a connected system

beats.development: Action: the hand follows through as the bulb arcs along a dashed trail onto the board and becomes the filled core node with a pale ripple; the 'shared system' label appears; the right figure steps toward the board, each foot lifting on an arc and planting.
Result: the right figure's hand plants on the board edge; three nodes pop and six edges draw from the core into a connected network, then the full outcome holds from about 2.3 s.

findings: Three poses (choice, action, result) each get a brief hold; the result is settled before 2.7 s.
justifiedHolds: 0.6-0.85 s choice pose hold so the claimed idea reads before it moves.
2.3-3.0 s outcome hold for the connected system and caption.

notes: Silent preview: no music, effects or narration.
No reviewed preview recipes were supplied (STYLE.json has no tech.preview_recipes, and there is no BACKGROUND_REVIEW.json); the preview demonstrates the style's catalogued characteristic action.
Limbs use two-bone inverse kinematics so hands and feet stay at contact points; this is an illustrative approximation, not motion capture.
